data.gender_notes: Moujab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is brave and victorious. The name Moujab carries the meaning “Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Moujab usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Moujab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moujab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, the name Moujab is associated with courage, bravery, and triumph. It is a name that inspires strength and resilience, and those who bear this name are often seen as leaders and champions among their communities. In times of struggle or conflict, Moujab is a name that evokes images of fearless warriors and valiant heroes.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name Moujab carries profound spiritual significance. In Islam, bravery and victory are not only physical, but also spiritual accomplishments. Moujab can be seen as a reminder to strive for spiritual victory over our own self-destructive tendencies and to be brave in the face of adversity in our journey towards the eternal victory of paradise. It is a name that calls upon us to challenge ourselves to be the best versions of ourselves and to persevere in our faith and peace in Allah (SWT).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Brave" symbolizes The one who is brave and victorious. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Moujab serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of brave.
